name: Ollama
description: Run large language models locally (CPU, or GPU with drivers).
notes: An API, not a web page: use it from Open WebUI. Pull a model with: docker exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
compose:
services:
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:11434"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/ollama:/root/.ollama
